shorts.title:
Humans are NOT at the top
of the food chain

On paper, humans are
terribly designed

We hunted by running
animals to death

They had money and maps.
They still starved.

Why kids copy useless steps
(and chimps don't)

Only 4% of mammals
on Earth are wild

Try this: count what you
could make yourself
